simple.meaning: עִיִּים (ʻÎyîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “Ijim , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עִיִּים (H5864) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 33:45, with occurrences in Numbers, Joshua.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עִיִּים (H5864) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עִיִּים (H5864) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עִיִּים (ʻÎyîym) / H5864 is traced through Numbers 33:45, Joshua 15:29 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
